4067-5309-7902.description:
Activate Black Market Tycoon by tapping it, creating an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters, Fateful Discovery triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Black Market Tycoon.
Repeat.

1619-3967-4605-5542-6135.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-3967-4605-5542-6135.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Aarakocra Sneak from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Aarakocra Sneak enters, it and Preston trigger twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Aarakocra Sneak.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Aarakocra Sneak that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Aarakocra Sneak token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Aarakocra Sneak token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Aarakocra Sneak that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the first Aarakocra Sneak trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-3967-4605-5542-6135.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

5170-5231-6132-6772.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Syr Vondam triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to gain 1 life.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Syr Vondam trigger.
Resolve the Syr Vondam trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3967-6972-7153.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Arcbound Bruiser.
When Arcbound Bruiser dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Bruiser's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Bruiser from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

1879-2033-3490-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
1879-2033-3490-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

292-1495-6774.description:
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Rite of Passage triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Triskelion.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Move to the next turn, removing all damage marked on Triskelion.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat step 5 as desired.
292-1495-6774.notes: You can remove counters to deal damage to creatures you control, putting infinite +1/+1 counters on them due to Rite of Passage.

4772-5658-6245-6441.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You have the city's blessing or control at least six permanents.
4772-5658-6245-6441.description:
Declare Satya as an attacker. Satya triggers, creating four token copies of Ocelot Pride that are tapped and attacking and causing you to get {E}{E}.
If you don't have the city's blessing, the Ocelot Pride token gives you the city's blessing.
At the beginning of your end step, Satya triggers four times, and each Ocelot Pride you control triggers once.
Resolve the first Ocelot Pride trigger, causing you to create three 1/1 Cat creature tokens if you gained life this turn, and then causing you to create three token copies of each creature token that entered the battlefield under your control this turn, and then causing you to create a token copy of each noncreature token that entered the battlefield under your control this turn.
Repeat step 4 for each remaining trigger.
4772-5658-6245-6441.notes: You may repeat this loop during subsequent turns to get even more creature tokens and ETB triggers.

1170-1645-5921-5954-6664.description:
Cast Crown of Flames by paying {G}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Resolve the Crown of Flames spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Crown of Flames by paying {G}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

5413-5720-5721-6664.notablePrerequisites:
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
Lands you control and/or land cards in your graveyard that enter the battlefield untapped can tap to produce at least {5}{G}{G}{G}.
5413-5720-5721-6664.description:
Activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing any land except Shifting Woodland.
Repeat step 1 until you control no other lands except Shifting Woodland.
Activate Shifting Woodland's second ability by paying {2}{G}{G}, causing it to become a copy of Aftermath Analyst until end of turn.
Activate Shifting Woodland by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning it and all other land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

856-2267-2829-5776.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Tormod trigger.
Resolve the Tormod trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability.
Repeat.

224-1525-3534-4913.notablePrerequisites:
You control seven or more lands with different names.
Zimone and Dina does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional creature.
224-1525-3534-4913.description:
Activate Zimone and Dina by tapping it and sacrificing another creature, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card, put it into your hand, then put the land onto the battlefield tapped, and repeat this process once if you control at least eight lands.
Retreat to Coralhelm and Field of the Dead trigger for each land that enters the battlefield this way.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger(s), untapping Zimone and Dina.
Resolve the Field of the Dead trigger(s), creating that many creature tokens.
Repeat.

654-880-6528.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
654-880-6528.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Elfsworn Giant and Amulet of Vigor trigger.
Resolve the Elfsworn Giant trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping the land.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with at least two +1/+1 counters on it

1029-1597-5028.description:
Activate Gyre Sage by tapping it, adding at least two mana of any color.
Activate Arcanis's first ability by tapping it, causing you to draw three cards.
Tolarian Kraken triggers three times. Resolve the first two triggers, causing you to pay {2} to untap Arcanis and Gyre Sage.
Resolve the last Tolarian Kraken trigger, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.
1029-1597-5028.notes: If mana allows, you can untap a creature using Tolarian Kraken's third trigger - although it is not necessary to execute the combo.

1977-4365-4499.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Tivit.
When Tivit enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to create at least four Treasure tokens.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}.
Repeat.
1977-4365-4499.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may instead vote to get Clue tokens.

1617-1810-4831-4983-5358.notablePrerequisites:
You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {G}.
You have enough mana to cast Cackling Counterpart.
1617-1810-4831-4983-5358.description:
Cast Cackling Counterpart by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Bellowing Aegisaur.
Activate a mana-producing permanent you control by tapping it, adding at least {G}.
Activate Wayta by paying {G} and tapping it, causing Cacophodon and the nontoken Bellowing Aegisaur to fight each other, with each only taking 1 damage due to Temple Altisaur.
Cacophodon and Bellowing Aegisaur each trigger twice.
Resolve all Bellowing Aegisaur triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on each other creature you control.
Resolve both Cacophodon triggers, untapping the mana-producing permanent and Wayta.
Repeat from step 2, alternating between having the token and nontoken Bellowing Aegisaur fight Cacophodon.
1617-1810-4831-4983-5358.notes: Once you have infinite +1/+1 counters, you may instead have Cacophodon fight another creature you control.

5058-6054.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with toughness equal to 1.
5058-6054.description:
Cast Screams from Within by paying {1}{B}{B}, attaching it to a creature with toughness equal to 1.
The creature dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Gremlin Tamer and Screams from Within trigger.
Resolve the Gremlin Tamer trigger, creating a 1/1 Gremlin creature token.
Resolve the Screams from Within trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Gremlin.
Repeat from step 2.

1379-3259-4885-5953.easyPrerequisites: Breath of Fury attached to any other creature you control.
1379-3259-4885-5953.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1379-3259-4885-5953.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury and Aya of Alexandria trigger.
Resolve the Aya of Alexandria trigger, creating a 1/1 Assassin creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Assassin token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

116-2569-4753.notablePrerequisites:
Clever Impersonator is a copy of Kiora's Follower.
Kiora's Follower and Clever Impersonator do not have summoning sickness.
116-2569-4753.description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it.
When Kiora's Follower becomes tapped, Judge of Currents triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve Kiora's Follower's ability from step 1, untapping Clever Impersonator.
Activate Clever Impersonator by tapping it.
When Clever Impersonator becomes tapped, Judge of Currents triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve Clever Impersonator's ability from step 4, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.

2511-2724-3582-3987.description:
Activate Kaya the Inexorable's first ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, putting a ghostform counter on Wormfang Manta.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Wormfang Manta.
When Wormfang Manta dies, its second ability and its ghostform ability trigger.
Resolve the ghostform trigger, returning Wormfang Manta from your graveyard to your hand and creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the second trigger, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Wormfang Manta by paying {5}{U}{U}.
Wormfang Manta's first ability does not trigger due to Torpor Orb.
Repeat each turn.

509-1267-3933-5517.manaNeeded: {1}{U}{R} available the first turn, with {4} each extra turn
509-1267-3933-5517.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Medomai the Ageless has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
509-1267-3933-5517.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Medomai the Ageless.
Medomai the Ageless triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Idris by paying {1}{U}{R}.
When Idris enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Medomai the Ageless until Idris leaves the battlefield.
Move to your extra turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Idris's vanishing ability triggers, removing a time counter from it.
Activate Karn's Bastion's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, putting a time counter on Idris.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Idris.
Idris triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat from step 5.

618-1558-2567-3263.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four lands.
618-1558-2567-3263.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Avenger of Zendikar with haste.
When the Avenger of Zendikar token enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, creating at least four 0/1 Plant creature tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it, sacrificing the Avenger of Zendikar token and the Plant tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Loyal Retainers

2533-2719-3388.notablePrerequisites: It is your precombat main phase.
2533-2719-3388.description:
During your precombat main phase, activate Sakashima of a Thousand Faces by sacrificing it, returning Moritte of the Frost from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Loyal Retainers.
Activate Moritte of the Frost by sacrificing it, returning Sakashima of a Thousand Faces from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Loyal Retainers.
Repeat.

1350-4872-5238.notablePrerequisites: Ethereal Forager does not have summoning sickness.
1350-4872-5238.description:
Declare Ethereal Forager as an attacker.
Ethereal Forager triggers, returning Time Warp from exile to your hand.
Activate Termur Sabertooth by paying {2}{W}, returning Ethereal Forager to your hand from the battlefield.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ethereal Forager by paying {3}{U}{U} and exiling Time Warp from your graveyard.
Chulane triggers, causing you to draw a card and allowing you to put a land from your hand onto the battlefield.
Repeat each turn.

1308-3199-3209.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least three opponents.
You control at least two untapped creatures, one of which must be green.
1308-3199-3209.description:
Activate Spellbinding Soprano's encore ability by paying {3}{R} and exiling it from your graveyard, creating a token copy of it with haste for each opponent you have.
Declare each Spellbinding Soprano token as an attacker.
Each Spellbinding Soprano token triggers, causing instant and sorcery spells you cast this turn to cost {1} less to cast for each Spellbinding Soprano token.
Cast Sprout Swarm with buyback by tapping a green creature and any other creature you control, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens and returning Sprout Swarm to your hand.
Repeat step 4.

3750-3976-5211.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
You control at least six lands.
3750-3976-5211.description:
Activate Magar by paying {1}{B}{R}, noting Brass's Bounty and putting it face down as a 3/3 creature.
On any other turn, deal combat damage to an opponent with the face down creature.
The face down creature triggers, causing you to cast a copy of Brass's Bounty without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the copy of Brass's Bounty, creating at least six Treasure tokens.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate five Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

2408-3676-4050.notablePrerequisites: You have cast at least 4 other spells this turn.
2408-3676-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Thrasta to add {G}.
Choose to put Thrasta in the command zone.
Cast Thrasta for {G}{G}.
Tangleroot triggers, adding {G}.
Repeat.

290-1358-1978.description:
Animate Dreamstone Hedron using Sydri.
Activate Dreamstone Hedron by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Dreamstone Hedron.
Repeat from step 2.
